verdict.rationale: Supabase Cron is a first-party Postgres module for scheduling recurring jobs with cron syntax, from every second to once a year. Jobs can be created via SQL or the Dashboard, can run SQL, database functions or HTTP calls such as Edge Functions, and job runs can be monitored inside Postgres. Supabase Queues adds durable background-task processing. Because jobs can be created with SQL, an agent could plausibly schedule them through the MCP execute_sql tool, though no doc says so explicitly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Cron, explicit documentation of agent-driven scheduling, and multi-step workflow orchestration beyond single jobs and queues.
